expected_symptom: IDxcLinker::Link's result, QueryInterface'd to IDxcResult, never carries a DXC_OUT_PDB output when linked with -Zi -Qstrip_debug: HasOutput(DXC_OUT_PDB) is FALSE and GetOutput(DXC_OUT_PDB, ...) returns E_INVALIDARG.
godbolt_skip: linker-only defect (no DXC_OUT_PDB output object set by IDxcLinker::Link); Compiler Explorer exposes one dxc invocation per pane and no dxl/linker equivalent, and even the dxc/dxl CLI never reaches DXC_OUT_PDB on a linked result, so the symptom cannot be produced there
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Confirmed via a raw COM harness (registered as compiler main-debug-pdb5721, since no dxc/dxl command line reaches IDxcResult::GetOutput on a linked result): IDxcLinker::Link(...,-Zi,-Qstrip_debug) succeeds, but the linked IDxcResult never has a DXC_OUT_PDB output (HasOutput=FALSE, GetOutput=E_INVALIDARG), while a same-object self-test (GetOutput(DXC_OUT_OBJECT) succeeds) and a same-flags/same-source direct-compile control (produces a real PDB) both isolate the gap specifically to the linker path. Root cause: tools/clang/tools/dxcompiler/dxclinker.cpp's Link() sets DXC_OUT_OBJECT/DXC_OUT_ROOT_SIGNATURE/DXC_OUT_SHADER_HASH/DXC_OUT_REFLECTION (added by PR 5678) but never DXC_OUT_PDB, marked only by a bare TODO comment. An open, unmerged PR (6834, 'Add PDB output to linker') already targets this fix. Reproduces unchanged on ground truth 89e2f98e2.
title: DXC linker API doesn't include DXC_OUT_PDB in the result
